'''The Legendary Pokémon Appears!!''' (Japanese: '''伝説のポケモン現る!!''' ''Legendary Pokémon Appears!!'') is the third chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
The chapter begins with [[Nurse Joy]] and [[Professor Oak]] at the [[Violet City]] [[Pokémon Center]] wondering about a large black thundercloud in the shape of a spiraling whirlpool that suddenly appeared over the city. They check their watches, and the times they have are different. Professor Oak states that [[Bill]] had created a [[Time Capsule]], and then he deduces that the Time Capsule must be creating a time warp. They run to check out the [[Violet Gym]], only to find {{GnB|Gold}} facing [[Falkner]] and {{p|Articuno}}, who only returns to the Gym every four years. Professor Oak expresses his concerns for Gold, and his battle against Articuno. Gold offers to battle Articuno himself so that his Pokémon don't get hurt, but gets chastised by Falkner. He then realizes that having an {{t|Electric}} Pokémon would be helpful in defeating Articuno.

Suddenly, the time warp bursts through the roof, opens, and a {{TP|Gold|Pikachu}} appears before everyone. The clouds clear from the sky. {{p|Pikachu}} instantly warms up to Gold, but upon seeing Articuno, jumps right into battle. Falkner states that it must be at an extremely high level, because it won't listen to its Trainer. Gold sends {{TP|Gold|Totodile}} and {{TP|Gold|Pidgey}} out to help Pikachu. Falkner transforms the Gym when he realizes that it is much too small for Articuno. Pikachu and Articuno exchange attacks: Pikachu uses {{m|Thunder}} while Articuno uses {{m|Ice Beam}}. Because Thunder is such a large scale attack, it misses. Gold yells to Pikachu that if Articuno is going to be weakened, it has to be hit with something like {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Pikachu refuses to listen, and its leg freezes because of Articuno's attack. Articuno readies another Ice Beam, but Gold commands {{p|Totodile}} to use {{m|Water Gun}}, thus creating an ice shelter protecting Pikachu. {{p|Pidgey}} pecks at Pikachu's leg to remove the ice.

Pikachu, although being a high level, agrees with Gold that it can't defeat Articuno alone. Pidgey distracts Articuno while Totodile utilizes the cold air around to create a pillar of ice leading to Articuno with its Water Gun. Pikachu strikes Articuno with electricity and tires out. Articuno then lets Pikachu fall to the ground and admits defeat by flying away. Falkner accepts defeat and awards Gold with the {{Badge|Zephyr}}.

==Major events==
* A {{TP|Gold|Pikachu}} comes from the future, and helps {{GnB|Gold}} during his battle with Falkner.
* Gold's Pokémon defeat [[Falkner]]'s {{p|Articuno}}, thus winning the {{Badge|Zephyr}}.
